funFacts: Chameleons don't change color to camouflage — they do it to regulate temperature and communicate.
Snakes smell with their tongues, collecting particles and analyzing them with the Jacobson's organ.
Some turtles can breathe through their butts — using cloacal respiration.
The Komodo dragon can reproduce asexually through parthenogenesis.
